description: Stadt Zürich (City of Zürich, Geomatik + Vermessung and Statistik Stadt Zürich) publishes the locations of the school facilities of the City of Zürich (kindergarten, day-care centres, primary schools and special schools) as CSV, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, shapefile and DXF. Coverage: the City of Zürich; the portal record was last modified on 2026-09-29. Format and access: CSV, DXF, GPKG, JSON, Shapefile, WFS, WMS, WMTS, downloadable without registration from the City of Zürich open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the portal describes the purpose only as locating the school sites, so the attributes (names, addresses, capacity) and the number of sites were not confirmed; no pupil numbers or building condition are given. Simulation uses: school locations as shelters and critical facilities in evacuation and emergency-response models, and for accessibility and catchment analysis. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
